unavailable.android: Qt 6.8.3 ships no Android build of Qt PDF; the qtpdf add-on exists for host and iOS targets only.

QtQuick.Pdf.notes: PDF rendering is an iOS-only mobile capability. An Android build that keeps a PDF adapter fails at configure time instead of starting without the module.

unavailable.ios: Qt Quick 3D Xr targets visionOS and Android XR; the iOS SDK ships no QtQuick3D.Xr module.
The macOS native style is a desktop style and ships only in the host SDK.
unavailable.android: The macOS native style is a desktop style and ships only in the host SDK.
The iOS native style ships only in the host and iOS SDKs.

QtQuick.Controls.iOS.notes: Selected through the Qt Quick Controls style name, not imported directly.

QtWebView.notes: QtWebView::initialize() has to run before the QGuiApplication is constructed; native/main.cpp does that behind ZUI_USES_WEBVIEW.

QtQuick.VirtualKeyboard.notes: Needs QT_IM_MODULE=qtvirtualkeyboard in the environment before the platform input context is created; native/main.cpp does that behind ZUI_USES_VIRTUAL_KEYBOARD.

QtQuick.LocalStorage.notes: Needs the sqlite SQL driver plugin; the tree shaker keeps plugins/sqldrivers when this module is retained.

QtQuick3D.notes: Runtime asset loading (QtQuick3D.AssetUtils) also needs the assetimporters plugins, which the tree shaker keeps for any retained QtQuick3D module.
